d: For 33 years, Jensen Huang built Nvidia into one of the most powerful companies in the world. But now, his reported exit has sent shockwaves through the tech industry. Elon Musk wants to hire him. Bill Ackman is asking people to support him. Donald Trump has even suggested a replacement. And more than 1,600 Nvidia employees reportedly want their boss back. Can the AI giant maintain its momentum without the person who built it? Palki Sharma tells you.
